description: A component with a type parameter, `function List<T>(props: ListProps<T>)`, inferred from its props at each call site.
Arrow-function generics need a trailing comma or `extends` in TSX so the parser does not read `<T>` as a JSX tag.
`T extends { id: string }` lets the component use members every item must have.
Callbacks typed with `T` (`onChange: (option: T) => void`) hand back the caller's own objects without casts.
